c.v: The ESP32-S3 integrates a large number of peripherals, and enables the control of individual peripherals to achieve optimal characteristics in performance-vs-power-consumption scenarios.

Specifically, ESP32-S3 has a various of system configuration registers that can be used for the chip's clock management (clock gating), power management, and the configuration of peripherals and core-system modules.
This chapter lists all these system registers and their functions.
